decision: At current 0.2mm clearance, stop must start at X>=1.58 while minimum body edge is X=1.55 even when centered. Stop resizing or lower-case relief alone cannot solve this configuration.
next_direction: Separate wire strain relief from sensor-body capture; review a seller-installed carrier or alternate surface-sensor package rather than shrinking insulation clearance to force this stop to pass.
limits: Necessary planar conditions only, not full mechanical feasibility.
0.1/0.15 scenarios illustrate tradeoff only; neither is adopted or printer-qualified.
Negative bilateral engagement at full lateral float does not prove single-sided escape; it shows both shoulders cannot be guaranteed engaged.
Published minimum width does not establish minimum shoulder length or safe contact force.
No battery or recording requirement changed.
